card.name: Phenylalanine content in chewable tablets
card.fires_on: Words and number starts just before a phenylalanine amount or ingredient name, in phenylketonuria warnings about chewable or dispersible tablets. Also fires on word starts in inactive-ingredient lists.

modes.label: Before phenylalanine amount
modes.description: The word 'contain(s)' or the space or first digit before a mg amount of phenylalanine.
modes.example: Each 200 mg chewable tablet contains<< >>1.82 mg phenylalan

modes.label: Inside inactive ingredient names
modes.description: The opening piece of an excipient name in an ingredient list.

card.plain: It lights up where a label is about to state how much phenylalanine a tablet contains, and sometimes in ingredient lists.
